# Draft:Transparent Working Directive 2019

The Transparent Working Directive 2019 ([https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/?uri=CELEX:32019L1152 2019/1152]) is an EU Directive that requires employers to give information and guarantee predictability in working conditions to employees.
Contents
*art 4, Obligation to provide information
*art 6, Modification of the employment relationship
*art 7, Additional information for workers sent to another Member State or to a third country
*art 8, Maximum duration of any probationary period is 6 months
*art 10, Minimum predictability of work
*art 11, Complementary measures for on-demand contracts
*art 18, Protection from dismissal and burden of proof
See also
*EU law
*European labour law
